cases.excerpt: During follow-up from 1995 through 2004, 307 men were newly diagnosed with prostate cancer, of which 74 cases were advanced, 220 cases were organ localized, and 13 cases were of an undetermined stage.

continent.excerpt: The incidence of prostate cancer is much lower in Asian than Western populations.

design.excerpt: Here, we conducted a population-based prospective study

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Participants responded to a validated questionnaire, which included 147 food items.

sample_size.excerpt: Here, we conducted a population-based prospective study in 43,509 Japanese men ages 45 to 74 years who generally have a high intake of isoflavones and low incidence of prostate cancer. Participants responded to a validated questionnaire, which included 147 food items.
